about: osaurus bench speed rows (LM.PROBES; LM.DESIGN section 4's speed floor). One row per model and prompt size: medians of 3 uncached requests (greedy, 128 max tokens), from tools/bench.sh under the GPU lock (osaurus bench --prompt-tokens 1024,8192 --runs 3 --json). load_1m is the machine's 1-minute load average at the start and end of that model's run: other agents share this Mac, so a row read under load is slow, never fast, and the 27B 8192 decode samples (13.8, 7.0, 11.4) show it. OPEN: raptor-v0.5-8b-a1b-jang_6m, gemma-4-e4b-it-8bit and lfm2.5-350m-optiq-4bit, refused at load 46 (their /health did not answer within 5 s), and a quiet-machine rerun of these four rows.
